claims.claim_atom: In the Source Data for Extended Data Fig. 1a (hippocampal SLM), the 'Total SPP1 immunoreactivity per tile' column contains 15 tile-level rows for NLF drawn from only 9 mice: several mice contribute three tiles each that were counted as independent replicates (e.g. mouse NLF186 gives D28,D29,D30 = 21.696, 6.414, 28.463 — a >4-fold within-mouse spread). The corrected file itself adds a 'Per-mouse' column (F/G) that collapses these three tiles into a single per-mouse value G30 = 18.857667 ('NLF186 average (of datapoints 21.696; 6.414; 28.463)'). Treating the 15 tiles (and 16 WT tiles) as independent n inflates the degrees of freedom relative to the true unit of replication (the animal, n=9 NLF / n=10 WT), i.e. pseudoreplication that inflates the significance of the reported hippocampal SPP1 difference. This matches the PubPeer critique (15 NLF / 16 WT source points vs 8 plotted; p reported as 0.0499) and the pseudoreplication concern that the authors explicitly declined to correct.
claims._adjudication: 伪重复核心(inconsistent): ED Fig 1a 海马SLM 的 NLF 组 source data 有 15 个 tile 级数据点, 但只来自 9 只鼠——NLF130/NLF186/NLF188 三只鼠各贡献 3 个 tile 被当独立重复。以 NLF186 为例, D28/D29/D30=21.696/6.414/28.463 同鼠内跨 4 倍以上极离散, 更正文件自己新增 Per-mouse 列把三 tile 塌成一只鼠均值 G30=18.8577。把 15 个 tile(WT 16 个)当独立 n 抬高自由度、膨胀所报海马 SPP1 差异的显著性(所报 p=0.0499)。这正是 PubPeer 指出的'source 15/16 点 vs 图上各 8 点、伪重复'。作者在 #31 明确表示更正不涵盖伪重复问题。verdict=inconsistent, discrepancy_type=pseudoreplication。

claims.claim_atom: The paper's headline claim for this panel is that SPP1 upregulation is region-specific — elevated in hippocampus but NOT in cerebellum. In the cerebellum half (Extended Data Fig. 1b), collapsing to the corrected per-mouse values shows no NLF elevation: a representative NLF cerebellar mouse G14 = 6.4735 is LOWER than a representative WT cerebellar mouse G16 = 7.67, and across the panel the NLF and WT per-mouse cerebellar means overlap (NLF ~= 8-10, WT ~= 9-11). Thus the 'no SPP1 upregulation in cerebellum' half of the region-specificity statement is direction-robust to per-mouse aggregation and is not affected by the pseudoreplication that inflates the hippocampal comparison. This is consistent with the authors' response that per-mouse re-analysis (e.g. Fig. 1b per-mouse P = 0.0043) does not overturn the qualitative regional finding.
claims._adjudication: 合法子断言(consistent): 论文对该面板的核心说法是 SPP1 升高'区域特异'——海马升高、小脑不升高。小脑(ED Fig 1b)按 per-mouse 塌回后 NLF 并不高于 WT: 代表性 NLF 小脑鼠 G14=6.4735 < 代表性 WT 小脑鼠 G16=7.67, 全面板 NLF/WT 小脑 per-mouse 均值重叠。即'小脑不升高'这一半在 per-mouse 聚合下方向稳健, 不受海马那侧伪重复的影响, 与作者 #34 per-mouse 重分析(如 Fig 1b per-mouse P=0.0043 仍显著)结论方向不变一致。AI 应把这半判为 consistent, 不因伪重复争议就否定整个区域特异结论。is_clean_claim=true。

claims.claim_atom: Whether the hippocampal SPP1 elevation is actually statistically significant once analysed at the mouse level, and whether the paper's 'region-specific' wording is justified, both hinge on a region x genotype interaction test (the mouse NLF107 is measured in both regions: SLM D23 = 13.0715 vs CB D2 = 12.603333, and other mice similarly), which was never reported. Multiple commenters (and a Nature Neuroscience tutorial cited in the thread) note the paper compares two separate p-values on either side of 0.05 rather than testing the interaction, and never provides the per-mouse P value for ED Fig. 1a. The published Correction (s41593-025-02197-6) revised some statistics and source files but the corresponding author stated the pseudoreplication concern would NOT be addressed, and the region-specificity interaction remains untested in the public record. Adjudication of whether the hippocampus-vs-cerebellum region specificity holds is therefore pending.
claims._adjudication: 待定(insufficient): '海马升高是否真显著(在鼠层面)'与'区域特异措辞是否成立'都取决于 region×genotype 交互检验——同一只鼠 NLF107 两区都测(SLM D23=13.0715 vs CB D2=12.6033), 具备做交互的配对结构, 但该交互从未被报告。多位评论者(及线程引用的 nn.2886 教程)指出论文靠'两个 p 值各在 0.05 两侧'下结论而非直接检验交互, 也从未给出 ED Fig 1a 的 per-mouse P。已发布的更正(s41593-025-02197-6)改了部分统计与 source 文件, 但通讯作者明确表示伪重复问题不在更正范围, 区域特异所需的交互检验在公开记录中仍缺失。故区域特异是否成立=待定。verdict=insufficient。

metadata._lane: 伪重复(pseudoreplication)型 mixed(三 verdict): ①inconsistent=ED Fig 1a 海马SLM 每只鼠多个 tile 被当独立重复(NLF 15 tile 仅来自 9 鼠, 如 NLF186 三 tile D28:D30 塌成 per-mouse G30), 膨胀显著性; ②consistent=小脑(ED Fig 1b)per-mouse 下 NLF 不高于 WT(G14<G16), '小脑不升高'方向稳健, 与作者 per-mouse 重分析结论不变一致; ③insufficient=区域特异真正需要的 region×genotype 交互检验(同鼠 NLF107 两区 D23 vs D2)从未报告、per-mouse 海马 P 未公开、更正明确不涵盖伪重复→待定。考 AI 区分'伪重复导致的膨胀显著性(inconsistent)'、'per-mouse 聚合后仍稳健的合法子结论(consistent)'与'缺交互检验/未公开无法判定(insufficient)'。
metadata._author_response: 通讯作者 Soyon Hong 团队回应(PubPeer #31/#34): #31 承认定稿最后一步'人为失误上传了错误的 source data 文件', 2023-11 已联系编辑, 将发更正并附正确 source data; 称重查后仅有少量统计需改, 改后各图显著/非显著结论不变; 但明确表示伪重复问题不在更正范围(认为按微胶质细胞/突触为单位有合理性)。#34 提供 per-mouse vs per-microglia 并列再分析: Fig 1b per-mouse P=0.0043(去离群后 0.0008), Fig 4f per-mouse 交互 P=0.0007、Spp1 基因型 0.0010、APP 突变 <0.0001(two-way ANOVA), 称 per-mouse 与 per-microglia 结果相似、不改变结论。
